notes: Paco Morningstar's Tarot starts fresh at version 1.0.
iPhone: nothing to do. The app moves to the new version by itself.

Android: this is a NEW app that installs next to the old one. BEFORE downloading, open ☰ → Settings & Backup → Export backup and save the file. Then install the new app, open it, use Import backup and choose that file. When your readings are there, uninstall the old app.
New on Android: updates download and install inside the app, and with Automatic updates on (Settings & Backup → Updates) they happen by themselves.
